## Application Menu Bar
- Menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar Area
### Quick Access Toolbar
- Icons for: New document, Open document, Save document, Print document, Undo, Redo, Find, Spelling and grammar check, Clone formatting (with tooltip: "Clone Formatting (double click and Ctrl or Cmd to alter behavior)")

### Formatting Toolbar
- **Paragraph Style Dropdown**: "Default Paragraph Style"
- **Text Formatting Icons**:
  - Bold (B)

  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)

  - Subscript (A_)
  - Font color (A with color dropdown)
  - Highlight color (A with highlight dropdown)
- **Alignment Icons**:
  - Left align
  - Center align
  - Right align
  - Justify
- **List and Indentation Icons**:
  - Bulleted list
  - Numbered list
  - Decrease indent
  - Increase indent
- **Other Formatting Icons**:
  - Text direction
  - Special characters (Ω)
  - Link
  - Comment
  - Table
  - Drawing tools (pen, shapes)

## Document Area
- Blank white page with a blinking cursor at the top-left corner
- Page margins visible
- Page number indicator: Page 1 of 1

## Sidebar (Right Panel)
- Vertical scrollbar
- Sidebar icons (from top to bottom):
  - Document properties
  - Drawing tools
  - Styles
  - Page layout
  - Master page
  - Object styles

## Status Bar (Bottom)
- Page information: Page 1 of 1
- Word count: 0 words, 0 characters
- Page style: Default Page Style
- Language: English (Hong Kong)
- Zoom level: 100%
- Zoom control: Minus, Zoom slider, Plus

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- Application icons (from top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer (selected)
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## System Tray (Top Right)
- System icons: Sound, Network, Power

## Additional UI Elements
- **Tooltip**: "Clone Formatting (double click and Ctrl or Cmd to alter behavior)" appears over the Clone Formatting icon
- **Document Title Bar**: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Writer"
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- **System Menu**: "Activities" in top-left corner
- **Application Icon**: LibreOffice Writer icon in top-left corner of the window
